title: Casablanca
tagline: Rick's runs the tables. We run the kitchen.
about: A cynical American nightclub owner in wartime Casablanca has to decide whether to help his old flame escape.
cue: Pour the mint tea when Sam sits down at the piano in Rick's.
faces: Rick's has the best table in town tonight, and the champagne is on the house. Do try to leave quietly.
Rick's runs the tables. We run the kitchen.
